Airranger's latest update introduces the day and night effects of the city scene. Days and nights appear randomly,the battlefield is more diverse.

New rules for modules
The module becomes a fixed device and is stored in the weapon slot and will not fall off automatically.

 Fixed a bug where the index device operation prompt was incorrect in the tutorial.
 Fixed a bug where blood volume and helmet durability did not change on the personal information panel.
 Fixed a bug that turned around in the air to see the bow on the back.

notes.content:

Hi everyone,

Airranger's latest update introduces our new official room and birth cabin game! Players can get more rewards in the official event room that is refreshed in a limited time. The birth cabin game makes the game's 30-second countdown fun.

In addition to our latest features, we've fixed some issues that have a negative impact on the gaming experience.

Read on for all the details of what Update V1.0 .1has to offer!

New Feature：
Official room
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33024512/65a89e357aacde8804ffad34f69be1c330c0d2eb.jpg
· The special property of the room is double gold coins. (More special properties will be available soon)
· The room is a fixed room and is automatically refreshed every half hour. All gamers can join this room to participate in the competition, the maximum number of people is 10.
· The room mode is solo, and the map is randomly selected. There is a game countdown in the room, and the countdown ends to automatically enter the game.

Birth Cabin Game
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33024512/ba6c209d55e02c75999bdedfad85ee3f35a77887.jpg

 Displayed on the main screen of the birth hat, the player can start the game after being born in the cabin.
 Game core gameplay:

     Use the helmet to swing left and right to control the chicken to traverse from side to side, avoiding the arrow that falls from above.
     Avoid as many arrows as possible to win higher scores. When you are hit by an arrow, you will deduct 20 points.

 The game will automatically end in the last 5 seconds of the game countdown. The hatch is about to open and the player is ready to fight.

Game-play optimization

 Pick up melee weapons in the state of bow, not immediately replaced with melee weapons.
 When the last player finishes the game and the game is settled, the player who has not left the room will automatically return to the main interface after 60 seconds.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug that changed the way the archery in the game is always lazy.
 Fixed a bug that caused two right hands to appear after chick recovery.
 Fixed a bug where the English text of the community interface exceeded the border.
 Fixed a bug where the text above the war mode rankings showed errors.

Thank you for your continued support.
- The Chesstar Team

New map is smaller and more refined than before

Hello everyone,

Since the release of version 0.7.9.2, we received a lot of feedback from the community and email. With these feedbacks and the analysis to the player’s data, we did a lot of works in this week. 

Updates
Added a support language - Korean

The players of Walk on Arrow come from all over the world, and a large proportion of them come from Korean. So we decided to add a support language - Korean, to help them play Walk on Arrow more easily. Now the Korean script was translated from the English scripts by the aid of Google translation, so there must be many mistake or improper usage, but we will consistently adjust the translation.

Added a Settings button to the main UI

Now the language of Walk on Arrow is decided by your PC’s system language, and it may bring some trouble to you. To prevent this from happening, we added a settings button to the main UI. In the Settings UI, you can choose which language was used in the game, now there are three available languages for you to select, which are English, Chinese and Korean. You can also choose the game control method matching your handedness in this UI.

New methods of operating radar

To help players better-using radar we changed the way to activate radar. Now when a radar was ready, a floating hand image will appear beside it. If you put your hand into it and hold your hand still for few seconds, the radar will be activated and emit a shockwave revealing all other players in the map.

New Kill Inform

A multiplayer battle-royale game with third-class kill inform is unqualified. In this version, we greatly enhanced the kill inform you received when you kill your opponent or being killed by your opponent so that you can better immerse yourself in the fierce battle.

Guardian Mode

Now when the energy crystal is being attacked, it will turn red

Bug Fixes

Fixed a bug that death due to drown or put the head into obstacles will not change Survival points
Fixed a bug in Guardian Mode that when you killed by a monster the monster will continue attacking you until you being revived.
Fixed a bug in Guardian Mode that the BGM’s volume will randomly change
Fixed a bug in Guardian Mode that the countdown in the starting period may cause the picture frozen.
Fixed a bug in Guardian Mode that when a monster shot from the basement, the bullet may pierce through the wall
Fixed a bug in Guardian Mode that a bomb arrow deals the same damage as a normal arrow

By the way

We are keeping try our best to enlarge the number of players of Walk on Arrow. We will release Walk on Arrow on the platform of Viveport by this month. Plus, we will soon release a PC version of Walk on Arrow on the platform of Steam.


Are you ready to accept the challenge from all platforms and enjoy the fun of archery duel?

Chesstar studios
